executive_summary: The agent upgraded five connectors (boku, phonepe, santander, square, stripebilling) from Alpha/Beta to Live. These are purely metadata changes to `integration_status` fields. The compilation check passed successfully. However, the agent modified a completely disjoint set of connectors from the gold/reference patch and did not catch any connectors that were over-stating their readiness (e.g., aci, finix, payload, dwolla being downgraded).

approach_analysis.explanation: The agent chose a different subset of connectors to update, upgrading five connectors from Alpha/Beta to Live. The changes are mechanically correct and compile. However, the approach is incomplete: the gold patch also downgraded four connectors (aci, finix, payload, dwolla) and upgraded six others (amazonpay, calida, gigadat, loonio, nuvei, peachpayments) that the agent entirely missed. A full audit should catch both understated and overstated maturity levels.

breaking_changes.description: Changing connector integration_status from Alpha/Beta to Live alters the public metadata exposed by ConnectorSpecifications::get_connector_about. Downstream consumers relying on status filtering may see these connectors appear in Live/Sandbox queries where they previously did not.
breaking_changes.evidence: boku.rs:779, phonepe.rs:627, santander.rs:1082, square.rs:927, stripebilling.rs:992 - all changed to ConnectorIntegrationStatus::Live
